purpose: Offline validation corpus for a future evaluator generation (V4). Every entry is drawn from a PRESERVED live report between revisions r5 and r10, or is a deliberate counterexample that must keep failing. This file is DATA ONLY — no evaluator logic, no thresholds, no scenario-specific patches. r10 remains frozen byte-identical.
notes: expected = what a correct evaluator must conclude about the MATERIAL CLAIM of the excerpt.
r10Behavior records what frozen r10 actually did, so confusion counts can be computed offline.
No scenario id, fixture contract number, or person name may be special-cased by an evaluator; the scenario/contract fields exist only for traceability of provenance.
